api: StagedCodeValidator.validate(prepared, route_result, *, expected_parent_pin, run_id, handoff_id, expected_revision, expected_event_sha256, input_operation_key, validation_operation_key, authorize_validate, authorize_read, validate_content_for, expected_candidate_sha256, draft=None, allow_historical_proposal=False, max_source_age_seconds=600, manual_review=None, authorize_manual_review=False, manual_review_content_for=None, trusted_verifier_id=None, trusted_verifier_key=None)
required_real_predecessors: EC170 single authorized bounded source with explicit source permission
EC171 genuinely created ACTIVE RunId and READY HandoffId
EC172 sealed committed private stage revision/last-event hash
EC173 immutable HMAC-sealed input and independent reentrant input read permission
EC174 route result from dispatch with a schema/anchor checked unverified candidate
independent_authorization: authorize_read=true and validate_content_for=exact EC173 source mode
validation_operation_key=separate valid key; does not change EC173 store
expected_candidate_sha256=externally pinned exact EC174 normalized candidate digest
historical ProposePR opt-in and exact source age limit

accepted_route_result.draft_evidence: source anchors rebuilt directly from EC173 segments and full-line quote; normalized candidate_sha256 recomputed and pinned

draft_rule: if supplied, draft must canonically match EC174 normalized result exactly; no post-approval text edits; absence reconstructs same immutable view in memory
deterministic_validations: strict exact v1 route and normalized finding field sets
source context+identity+evidence+material sha mode task run handoff revision event exact match
EC173 record/stage private HMAC expiry source age permissions checked before and after
all summary/text bounds, evidence segment+item+full line+anchor SHA+provenance rechecked
normalized whole candidate digest and optional draft exact equality
manual attestation bound to operation key, source, candidate, every finding, review time, expiry and configured HMAC verifier

available_only_with: trusted_verifier_id is an operator-pinned ASCII id
trusted_verifier_key is independently provisioned 32-64 byte secret
manual_review_attestation.review_mac: HMAC_SHA256(key, b'CES-EC175-TRUSTED-REVIEW-v1\x00' + canonical_json(record_without_mac)); expected verifier key NEVER from draft, EC172 key, AI callback or source
manual_review_attestation.proof_scope: local possession of separately configured key only; independent reviewer identity and semantic truth NOT cryptographically or empirically established
signer_does_not_prove: any Git or business write permission
a Finding record or CodeSave approval

cli.entrypoint: python construction/codevalidate_staged.py --prepared ... --route-result ... [source, operation and authorization flags]
cli.output: bounded metadata/digests only; not raw segment lines/draft text
